ResizeDisk.unit.gib.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the unit list's gibibytes.

ResizeDisk.newSize.message: It will be {{size, bytes}} (sizes are rounded up to a whole MiB).
ResizeDisk.newSize.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the line under the size field with the size the disk grows to. {{size}}: in KiB, MiB or GiB.

ResizeDisk.machines.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the line naming the machines whose disk grows. {{machines}}: their names, comma-separated.

ResizeDisk.machinesNone.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the line in place of ResizeDisk.machines when no machine's disk grows.

ResizeDisk.snapshots_one.message: A disk's size is part of the machine: the snapshot {{list}} can't be restored after this.
ResizeDisk.snapshots_one.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): a warning when the resize orphans a kept snapshot. {{list}}: the snapshot as ResizeDisk.snapshot says it; {{count}}: 1.

ResizeDisk.snapshots_other.message: A disk's size is part of the machine: these {{count}} snapshots can't be restored after this: {{list}}.
ResizeDisk.snapshots_other.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): a warning when the resize orphans kept snapshots. {{list}}: each as ResizeDisk.snapshot says it, comma-separated; {{count}}: how many.

ResizeDisk.snapshot.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): a snapshot in ResizeDisk.snapshots' list. {{name}}: the snapshot's name; {{machine}}: its machine's.

ResizeDisk.powerOff.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the button under the running machine's refusal when that machine is the one on this page; it asks first, as the page's other edits do. {{name}}: the machine.

ResizeDisk.grow.message: Grow the partition and filesystem at the next start
ResizeDisk.grow.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the box (on by default; not shown for a ramdisk) that has the guest grow its last partition and filesystem into the new space.

ResizeDisk.grow.note.message: Needs the guest agent. The partition that ends last grows, and its filesystem if it is mounted (ext4, btrfs or xfs). Without it, the new space is left free.
ResizeDisk.grow.note.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the fine print under ResizeDisk.grow.

ResizeDisk.cancel.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the button that closes the dialog without resizing.

ResizeDisk.ok.note: Resize dialog (Home page: Resize… on a stored disk's or a ramdisk's card in the Disks pane, on an overlay's row in Overlays…, or on a writable disk in a machine's Disks tab): the main button: grows the disk to the new size.

ResizeDisk.busy.note: Home page: what runs while the Resize dialog grows a disk or an overlay.

ResizeDisk.busy.powerOff.note: Home page: what runs while the Resize dialog powers off the machine on this page (its Power off button).

surface-job.inUse.message: A machine in another tab has this disk open: its map can be seen there, while it runs.
surface-job.inUse.note: The disk surface visualizer's window, in place of the map, when the disk (or the overlay chosen) is in use by a machine that runs in another tab: its files are locked, so this tab can't read what they hold.

surface-job.merging.message: A merge into this disk was interrupted. It completes the next time the disk is used, and its map can be seen after that.
surface-job.merging.note: The disk surface visualizer's window, in place of the map, when a merge of an overlay into this stored disk stopped half done (the tab closed meanwhile): its blocks are partly copied, so the map would be wrong until a machine (or a job) opens the disk and finishes the merge.

surface-job.unreadable.message: The disk's map can't be read from this browser's storage.
surface-job.unreadable.note: The disk surface visualizer's window, in place of the map, when reading the files of the disk (or of the overlay chosen) failed for a reason it has no words of its own for.

surface-look.legend.empty.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. A square whose part of the disk holds no data (it reads as zeros).

surface-look.legend.some.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. A square whose part of the disk holds some data (the faintest of four shades: any data at all).

surface-look.legend.full.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. A square whose part of the disk holds data in every block (the strongest shade).

surface-look.legend.ram.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. A ramdisk's square that holds some data in memory (the faintest of four shades).

surface-look.legend.opaque.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. A square whose contents aren't examined: of a disk whose image is a file or a URL that isn't read to tell what it holds, or of a qcow2 image under the parts of its tables (which say where its data is) not read yet.

surface-look.legend.absent.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. An outlined square past the end of the disk: the overlay laid over it is larger (grown), and only the overlay has this part.

surface-look.legend.changed.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. surface-look.why.large.message: The image's tables are too large to read for the map.
surface-look.why.large.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a disk whose image (a file) isn't examined (its squares are drawn flat, hatched): its first sentence, why: the image is a qcow2 whose tables (which say where its data is) are larger than the map reads (32 MiB), or couldn't be read, and none of them has been read yet.

surface-look.why.permission.message: This browser may read the image's file only once you allow it again (when its machine starts): until then its contents aren't examined.
surface-look.why.permission.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a disk whose image (a file or a URL) isn't examined (its squares are drawn flat, hatched): its first sentence, why: the image is a file on this computer that this browser has no read permission for now (it's asked for when the machine starts; the map never asks).

surface-look.why.remote.message: The disk's image is on a web server: what it holds is shown only while its machine runs in this tab.
surface-look.why.remote.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a disk whose image (a file or a URL) isn't examined (its squares are drawn flat, hatched): its first sentence, why: the image is a URL, examined only from what the running machine already has (nothing is downloaded for the map).

surface-look.why.unknown.message: The disk's image is a file or a URL, whose contents aren't examined.
surface-look.why.unknown.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a disk whose image (a file or a URL) isn't examined (its squares are drawn flat, hatched): its first sentence, when no reason of its own is known.

surface-look.keptAll.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a disk whose image is on a web server: a sentence after the others: {{size}} is how much of the image this browser keeps (in memory or in its storage), so it needn't download that again (of a qcow2, of its blocks with data); those squares have a green bar along their bottom edge.

surface-look.keptNone.message: This browser keeps none of it yet.
surface-look.keptNone.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a disk whose image is on a web server: a sentence after the others, when this browser keeps nothing of it yet (in memory or in its storage).

surface-look.overOpaque.message: The overlay's changes are shown over it.
surface-look.overOpaque.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a disk whose image (a file or a URL) isn't examined (its squares are drawn flat, hatched): its last sentence, with an overlay laid over the disk: its changes are drawn as inner squares.

surface-look.legend.keptSome.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. A square of an image on a web server of which this browser keeps part of what it holds there (in memory or in its storage), so it needn't download that again: a short green bar along the square's bottom edge, half its width, over the square's own look (the image's contents not examined, or a qcow2's blocks with data in shades).

surface-look.legend.kept.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the legend under the map, beside a square drawn as the map draws it. A square of an image on a web server of which this browser keeps all it holds there (in memory or in its storage): a green bar along the whole of the square's bottom edge, over the square's own look.

surface-look.disk.kept.message: Not examined: this browser keeps {{kept}} of its {{of}} blocks.
surface-look.disk.kept.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the line under the map while the pointer (or the keyboard's cursor) is on a square, which tells that square's numbers; one of its sentences. The disk's image is on a web server and isn't examined, but this browser keeps {{kept}} of the {{of}} blocks of this square (in memory or in its storage).

surface-look.range.kept.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the pinned square's details (beside the map, after a click on a square): one 4 MiB range of the disk, block by block; one of the sentences under its block map. After the one that says the image isn't examined: of the range's blocks, the {{blocks}} this browser keeps (in memory or in its storage) of an image on a web server; they have a green bar along their bottom edge.

surface-look.why.tablesSome.message: Some of the image's tables haven't been read yet, so the squares they cover aren't examined. They fill in as the guest reads them; the tables are never downloaded just for the map.
surface-look.why.tablesSome.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a qcow2 image on a web server of which part is examined: its first sentence, why some squares are drawn flat, hatched: the image's tables (which say where its data is) for them haven't been read or kept by this browser yet. The map shows them once the guest has read them; reading them for the map would download them, which it never does.

surface-look.why.largeSome.message: The image's tables are too large to read whole for the map, so the squares under those the guest hasn't read yet aren't examined.
surface-look.why.largeSome.note: The disk surface window (a disk's map, opened by "visualize" on a disk's line in the Home page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab). The line under the map while the pointer is on no square, for a qcow2 image in a file of which part is examined: its first sentence, why some squares are drawn flat, hatched: the image's tables (which say where its data is) are larger than the map reads (32 MiB), so only those the guest has read so far are used.
